mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diagnosis_report ( task_id, run_id, version, status, title, summary, content_markdown, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( CAST(#{taskId} AS uuid), CAST(#{runId} AS uuid), #{version}, #{status}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{contentMarkdown}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE diagnosis_report
task_id = CAST(#{taskId} AS uuid), run_id = CAST(#{runId} AS uuid), version = #{version}, status = #{status}, title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, content_markdown = #{contentMarkdown}, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, run_id, version, status, title, summary, content_markdown, created_at, updated_at FROM diagnosis_report WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)

SELECT id, task_id, run_id, version, status, title, summary, content_markdown, created_at, updated_at FROM diagnosis_report WHERE task_id = CAST(#{taskId} AS uuid) ORDER BY version DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, task_id, run_id, version, status, title, summary, content_markdown, created_at, updated_at FROM diagnosis_report ORDER BY updated_at DESC
